title: Glasgow through the ages: A sightseeing walk from the Cathedral to Glasgow Green
creator: Margaret Hubbard
description: A history walk through the oldest part of Glasgow, starting at the medieval cathedral and the legend of its patron saint, then down the old pilgrims’ high street past a herb garden and history murals, finishing in the city’s oldest public park.

title: Glasgow: The Merchant City
creator: Margaret Hubbard
description: A history of Glasgow’s trade wealth, from tobacco and cotton to heavy engineering and the city’s ties to slavery and abolition, starting in the main civic square and passing a cone-hatted equestrian statue, ending on a Georgian square uphill.

title: Ghouls and Gruesome Tales: A Glasgow Ghost tour with Where Now
creator: Where Now Audio
description: Ghost stories and grim history told by a local comedian, starting on the main civic square and taking in grave-robbing, a hilltop Victorian cemetery and a reputedly haunted hotel, finishing at one of the city’s oldest pubs near the river.

title: Stroll Through Time: A Walking Tour of Glasgow's West End
creator: Martin Webster
description: A history of the university district and its scientists, alumni and music venues, starting at a station on the small orange underground, passing the Gothic university cloisters and a grand red sandstone museum, ending in a pub inside a converted church.
